_comment: The release build matrix. One GUI binary per OS x CPU architecture: GPU support (CUDA, Metal, Vulkan, ROCm) is not a build dimension, because the bundled CLI downloads the matching llama.cpp asset on the user's machine at setup time. A target belongs here only if the bundled Python (runtime/python_version.json) and upstream's newt pin both have an asset for it -- tests/test_build_targets.py enforces that. 'runner' is a GitHub-hosted label; swap it for a self-hosted label (e.g. the Mac mini) without touching the workflow. 'bundles' is passed to `tauri build --bundles`.
